headline: Last session: Sensex and Nifty extended their four-week rally to hit nine-month highs on record FII buying.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Wednesday, 25 November.

why: Indian markets remained closed today due to the weekend schedule.
Strong record FII inflows pushed Sensex and Nifty to 9-month highs in recent sessions.
Banking and IT sector gains provided crucial support to market recovery.
Global tech and AI sell-off caused opening volatility earlier in the week.
whatHappening: APL Apollo agreed to acquire Tata Steel's tubes and colors business for ₹28,000 crore.
PNB MD stated that the ECL provision requirement of ₹5,000 crore will not impact profitability.
Shree Cement announced plans to cross 100 Mt capacity in 3-4 years with 9-10% growth target.
FSSAI sanctioned prosecution against Bisleri after finding packaged drinking water samples unsafe.
summary: Indian benchmark indices recently hit nine-month highs driven by record foreign institutional investor buying. Major corporate developments include APL Apollo's ₹28,000 crore deal to buy Tata Steel's tubes business and PNB reassuring investors on ECL provision impact. Shree Cement also announced aggressive expansion plans targeting 100 Mt capacity in 3-4 years.
